text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There have been no reports of serious ill effects from overdose of CHCs. Overdosage may cause withdrawal bleeding in females and nausea. If the ring breaks, it does not release a higher dose of hormones. In case of suspected overdose, all Etonogestrel/Ethinyl Estradiol Vaginal Ring rings should be removed and symptomatic treatment given.
